Mormare Dated: 10th February 2023 Pc:-
1.
Learned AGP for the State Government tenders a compilation.
He maintains that the property that is the subject matter of this Writ Petition was indeed subjected to a compulsory acquisition.
Mr Bulsara for the Petitioners, Chandiwala and Dimple who is the present owner of the property maintains that no compensation was ever paid for this acquisition.
The Petition, therefore seeks various prayers the effect of which is really a declaration that the acquisition must be held to have lapsed.

The consequent reliefs sought are for reversal or deletion of mutation 10th February 2023 914-OSWP-497-2023.DOC entries show the present Petitioners as transferees from the original owners.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Now the compilation tendered on behalf of the State Government has as part of it,
a notice under Section 12(2) of the Land Acquisition Act 1894.
This is addressed to the erstwhile owners, Mable Gracias and others at Gracias House, JB Nagar, Andheri (East).
It says that the amount of compensation then stated to be on 23rd October 1986 in the sum of Rs.6,84,547.79 has been deposited after apportionment.
The addressees were called to appear before the SLAO on 29th October 1986 to receive payment after proper identification.
Nobody came forward.
The instructions are to state that nobody has ever come forward.
At page 8 of this compilation is another notice of 23rd September 1986.
This appears to be in respect of a different portion of land.
There were apparently two awards.
They pertain to different survey numbers and Hissa numbers.
For the land at survey No. 42/4, the compensation awarded was Rs.7,32,061.40/-.
Even this was deposited but never claimed or collected.
3. A copy of the compilation is given to Mr Balsara in Court today.
He undoubtedly needs time to take instructions.
4. We also grant him leave to amend.
Amendments are to be carried out by 17th February 2023.
A copy of the amended Petition will be served on the Advocates for all the Respondents.
